topic: How does defocused reflector gain loss impact link budget margins for SNR compared to conventional designs?
consensus_response: Defocused reflectors exhibit reduced gain loss under feed element failures (4.95 dB vs. 6 dB) but broader beams with lower SNR margins, increasing the link budget cost due to spatial separation or additional capacity requirements. This trade-off in performance and cost is a critical consideration for system designers. In contrast, conventional designs suffer from higher average unit cell losses and reduced robustness against feed failures.
